task_summary: Plan concise release notes for fictional Atlas Notes 2.4.1. The required outcome is a maintenance-update note that states the reconnect sync-status-label fix, says offline edits were already queued before this update, adds no user-facing feature, and makes no sync-speed promise. Optional editorial polish stays separate and cannot change these facts. A reviewer checks the four required facts and confirms there is no extra promise.

decision_record.decision: Remove the draft implication that sync is faster.
decision_record.because: Performance is outside the update scope, and the note must not create a new customer-visible promise.
decision_record.risk: Leaving softer speed language could still imply a performance improvement.

decision_record.decision: Add that offline edits were already queued before version 2.4.1.
decision_record.because: This required fact prevents readers from mistaking existing queue behavior for a new feature.
decision_record.risk: Poor wording could imply that queuing was introduced or changed in this release.

decision_record.decision: Keep editorial improvements optional and subordinate to the outcome contract.
decision_record.because: Tone and brevity may improve readability, but they must not alter the required facts or release scope.
decision_record.risk: Editorial expansion could introduce unsupported claims or obscure the maintenance-only nature of the update.

proposed_change_manifest.change: State that Atlas Notes 2.4.1 fixes a sync status label that could retain stale text after reconnecting; offline edits were already queued; no user-facing feature is added; no faster-sync claim is made.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: These are the bounded customer-visible facts that the release note must preserve.

proposed_change_manifest.change: Require one reviewer to confirm all four required facts are present and that the final note contains no extra promise.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: This provides the specified acceptance check without expanding the release process.

proposed_change_manifest.change: Allow concise wording, sentence-order, and tone improvements only after the required content is stable.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: Editorial polish is useful but must remain separate from release scope and factual commitments.

acceptance_mapping.evidence: The plan explicitly identifies the release as Atlas Notes version 2.4.1.
The outcome contract states that the update fixes stale sync status label text after reconnecting.
The outcome contract explicitly says the update adds no new user-facing feature.
The plan requires the note to say offline edits were already queued before this update.
The draft's faster-sync implication is removed, and the outcome contract forbids a sync-speed claim.
The fixed checklist requires reviewer confirmation of the four facts and absence of any extra promise.
